headline: The app gets a light and dark mode button in the header that remembers each visitor's choice.
what_changed: A new button in the top bar of the Recipe Box page switches the colours between light and dark.
The button says "Dark" when the page is light, and "Light" when the page is dark.
On first visit, the page follows the visitor's device setting for dark mode.
The chosen mode is saved in the visitor's own browser, so it stays after a page refresh or a return visit.
The choice is not saved to customer accounts, so it does not follow the visitor to another device.
All buttons on the site now share the same new look: transparent background, thin border, rounded corners.
The colours fade smoothly over a fifth of a second when switching modes.
questions_for_developer: Are there any other buttons in the app that the new shared button look will change, and is that look wanted there too?
Does the recipe list use any fixed colours that will not change in dark mode? Please check the recipe cards on the dark background.
Is it acceptable that a page first shows in light colours for a moment before switching to dark, for visitors whose device prefers dark mode?
good_news: The change is small and contained: three files, no payments, no customer data, and no messages sent to anyone.
The saved setting only accepts the two valid values, so a bad saved value falls back to the device setting.
The button has a clear label for screen-reader users, so it is understandable without seeing the icon.
